This guide helps you upgrade from v1.5.x: This guide helps you upgrade from v1.5.x to v1.6.0. Version 1.6.0 requires Node.js 22 or later in every published package. Application logic is not affected, but your local environment, CI, Lambda runtime and Docker images must move to Node.js 22.

Node.js 18 and 20 are end of life and wi: Node.js 18 and 20 are end of life and will not receive the fix for CVE-2026-111497 (Node2Shell), a remote code execution vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js. The fix ships in Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1 and 26.12.1. `@mbc-cqrs-serverless/core` also now depends on nodemailer 10, which itself requires Node.js 20 or later. The framework CI tests Node.js 22 and 24.
